title: Knapsack Problem
definition: Given weights and values of N items, put these items in a knapsack of capacity W to get the maximum total value. A classic 0/1 (include or exclude) DP problem.
simpleExplanation: You are a burglar with a backpack that can only hold 50 pounds. Which items do you steal to get the absolute maximum amount of money?

answers.question: **Expert:** 0/1 Knapsack Problem
